identity.description: An attacker sets proxy environment variables to redirect network traffic through a compromised host for data exfiltration or command execution. Cortex detects this behavior via suspicious proxy environment variable settings.

payload.code:
export http_proxy=http://192.0.2.5:8080
export https_proxy=http://192.0.2.5:8080
export HTTP_PROXY=http://192.0.2.5:8080

biocs.name: Suspicious Proxy Environment Variable Setting
biocs.description: Detection of environment variables being set to redirect traffic through a non-standard proxy
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'bash'
| filter action_file_path contains 'export'
| filter action_file_path contains 'http_proxy'
| filter action_file_path contains '192.0.2.5'

abiocs.name: Proxy Environment Variable Manipulation
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a process modifies environment variables to route traffic through a known malicious IP
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'bash'
| filter action_file_path contains 'export'
| filter action_file_path contains 'http_proxy'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.5'

xql_queries.name: Find Processes Setting Proxy Variables
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_file_path contains 'export'
| filter action_file_path contains 'http_proxy'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.5'
